description: Everyday phrasing: questions asked the way people and assistants ask them, not the way the guides are titled. positives must mostly be answered strongly with an expected guide in the top three; boundary questions ask for a verdict, price or recommendation and must never be strong; outside questions belong to another subject and must never be strong. The second-look group was written after the gate was tuned and was not used to tune it. The noticed group (what people see, feel and smell, in their own words) was written after the noticed-words lexicon and was not used to build it. The review group is the outside review of 21 November 2026, run against the connected ChatGPT plugin; the third-look group was written after the fixes for it and was not used to make them. Questions with filters carry them. The old-home group (questions about a home's age) was used to build the era routing, so it is not unseen.
